```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (s : Set α) (f : α → α) (hf : ∀ x, f (f x) = x) : f '' (f '' s) = s := by
  apply Set.ext
  intro x
  split
  · intro h1
    rcases h1 with ⟨y, h2, h3⟩
    use f y
    split
    · exact h2
    · rw [Set.mem_image]
      use y
      split
      · exact h2
      · exact hf _ h2
  · intro h1
    rcases h1 with ⟨y, h2, h3⟩
    use y
    split
    · exact h3
    · rw [Set.mem_image]
      use f y
      split
      · exact h2
      · exact h3
```
